descEn: Monastery Units move +15% faster.

desc: 僧侣可以招降敌人的攻城武器和建筑 (除了城镇中心、城堡、修道院、农田、养鱼场、城墙、城门、世界奇观)。僧侣可以远距离招降大多数敌方单位，但对于建筑、冲车、巨型投石机必须靠近才能招降。
descEn: Monks can convert enemy Siege Weapons and buildings (except Town Centers, Castles, Monasteries, Farms, Fish Traps, Walls, Gates, and Wonders). Monks can convert most enemy units from a distance, but they must stand adjacent to buildings, rams, and Trebuchets to convert them.

desc: 僧侣可以招降敌方修道院单位。
descEn: Monks can convert enemy Monastery Units.

desc: 被敌方僧侣招降的单位立即死亡，而非变为敌方颜色。
descEn: Units converted by an enemy Monk die instead of changing to the enemy's color.

desc: 驻扎在建筑里的单位治疗速度 +500%。
descEn: Units garrisoned in buildings heal +500% faster.

desc: 单位被敌人僧侣招降的困难度增加 50%。
descEn: Units are 50% harder for enemy Monks to convert.

desc: 僧侣的招降距离 +3。
descEn: Monastery Units +3 conversion range.

desc: 成功招降后，修道院单位恢复信仰的速度 +100%。
descEn: Monastery Units regain their faith +100% faster after a successful conversion.

desc: 一群僧侣在招降同个敌方单位后，只有一个僧侣需要休息恢复。
descEn: If a group of Monks converts an enemy unit, only one of the Monks must rest afterward.

desc: 村民的生命值 +15，近战护甲 +1/远程护甲 +2。
descEn: Villagers +15 HP and +1 melee/+2 pierce armor.

desc:
升级到
封建时代
 (两个黑暗时代建筑)
增强您的文明。使您可以制造出不同的建筑，更强大的军事单位，以及更先进的科技。在您升级前，您必须拥有任两个黑暗时代建筑：伐木场，采矿场，磨坊，船坞或兵营。
descEn:
Advance to 
Feudal Age
 (; two Dark Age buildings)
Improves your civilization. Gives you access to different buildings, more powerful military units, and stronger technologies. Before you can advance, you must have any two Dark Age buildings: Lumber Camp, Mining Camp, Mill, Dock, or Barracks.

desc: 建筑的视野 +4。
descEn: Buildings +4 line of sight.

desc:
升级到
城堡时代
 (两个封建时代建筑)
增强您的文明。使您可以制造出不同的建筑，更强大的军事单位，以及更先进的科技。在您升级前，您必须拥有任两个封建时代建筑：靶场，马厩，铁匠铺或市场。
descEn:
Advance to 
Castle Age
 (; two Feudal Age buildings)
Improves your civilization. Gives you access to different buildings, more powerful military units, and stronger technologies. Before you can advance, you must have any two Feudal Age buildings: Archery Range, Stable, Blacksmith, or Market.

desc: 村民的运载量 +25%，移动速度 +10%。
descEn: Villagers +25% carry capacity and move +10% faster.

desc:
升级到
帝王时代
 (两个城堡时代建筑或一个城堡/营垒)
增强您的文明。使您可以制造出不同的建筑，更强大的军事单位，以及更先进的科技。在您升级前，您必须拥有一个城堡/营垒或任两个城堡时代建筑：大学，攻城武器厂或修道院。
descEn:
Advance to 
Imperial Age
 (; two Castle Age buildings or a Castle/Krepost)
Improves your civilization. Gives you access to different buildings, more powerful military units, and stronger technologies. Before you can advance, you must have a Castle/Krepost or any two Castle Age buildings: University, Siege Workshop, or Monastery.

desc: 村民的运载量 +50%，移动速度 +10%。
descEn: Villagers +50% carry capacity and move +10% faster.

desc: 建筑的视野 +4。
descEn: Buildings +4 line of sight.

desc: 建筑的生命值 +10%，近战护甲 +1/远程护甲 +1，建筑的护甲 +3。
descEn: Buildings +10% HP, +1 melee/+1 pierce armor and +3 building armor.

desc: 村民建造建筑的速度 +20%。
descEn: Villagers construct buildings +20% faster.

desc: 步弓手、掷矛手、骑射手、远程战船、远程防御工事和部分攻城武器对移动目标的射击准确度更高。
descEn: Foot Archers, Skirmishers, Mounted Archers, ranged Warships, ranged Fortifications and some Siege Weapons fire more accurately at moving targets.

desc:
升级到
防卫塔
 ()
将防卫塔升级为更强大的瞭望箭塔。
descEn:
Upgrade to 
Guard Tower
 ()
Upgrades Watch Towers to Guard Towers, which are stronger.

desc:
升级到
垛墙
 ()
将石墙和石门升级为更坚固的垛墙和城门。
descEn:
Upgrade to 
Fortified Wall
 ()
Upgrades Stone Walls and Stone Gates to Fortified Walls and Gates, which are stronger.

desc: 消除防御工事的最小射程，这样他们可以在基地攻击敌人。
descEn: Removes minimum range of Fortifications so they can attack enemies at their base.

desc: 船只的远程护甲 +1。
descEn: Ships +1 pierce armor.

desc: 塔楼对船只的攻击力 +125%；城堡对船只的攻击力 +4。
descEn: Towers +125% attack vs. ships; Castles and Docks +4 attack vs. ships.

desc: 船只移动速度 +10%。
descEn: Ships move +10% faster.

desc: 喷火船获得一次爆炸冲锋攻击。
descEn: Fire Ships gain an explosive charge attack.

desc:
步弓手、掷矛手、骑射手、远程战船和远程防御工事的攻击力 +1。
用于火药单位 (火枪手、炮舰、手推炮、炮塔)。
descEn:
Foot Archers, Skirmishers, Mounted Archers, ranged Warships and ranged Fortifications +1 attack.
Required for Gunpowder Units (Hand Cannoneer, Cannon Galleon, Bombard Cannon, Bombard Tower).

desc: 建筑的生命值 +10%，近战护甲 +1/远程护甲 +1，建筑的护甲 +3。
descEn: Buildings +10% HP, +1 melee/+1 pierce armor and +3 building armor.

desc:
升级到
大型箭塔
 ()
将防卫塔升级为更强大的大型箭塔。
descEn:
Upgrade to 
Keep
 ()
Upgrades Guard Towers to Keeps, which are stronger.

desc: 解锁炮塔。
descEn: Unlocks Bombard Towers.

desc: 船只的木材花费 -20%，建造速度 +50%。
descEn: Ships cost -20% wood and build +50% faster.

desc: 船只的远程护甲 +1。
descEn: Ships +1 pierce armor.

desc: 远程攻城武器和攻城战船的射程 +1。所有攻城武器和攻城战船对建筑的攻击力 +20%；爆破单位对建筑的攻击力 +40%。
descEn: Ranged Siege Weapons and Siege Warships +1 range. All Siege Weapons and Siege Warships +20% attack vs. buildings; Demolition Units +40% attack vs. buildings.

desc: 瞭望箭塔的攻击力 +1、防卫塔的攻击力 +2、大型箭塔和城楼的攻击力 +3。
descEn: Watch Towers +1, Guard Towers +2, Keeps and Donjons +3 attack.

desc: 船只移动速度 +10%。
descEn: Ships move +10% faster.

desc: 喷火船沉没时会引爆，扩大爆炸范围。
descEn: Fire Ships detonate when sunk, gaining blast radius.

desc: 村民采集木材的速度 +20%。
descEn: Villagers gather wood +20% faster.

desc: 村民采集木材的速度 +20%。
descEn: Villagers gather wood +20% faster.

desc: 村民采集木材的速度 +10%。
descEn: Villagers gather wood +10% faster.

desc: 村民采集黄金的速度 +15%。
descEn: Villagers gather gold +15% faster.

desc: 村民采集石料的速度 +15%。
descEn: Villagers gather stone +15% faster.

desc: 村民采集黄金的速度 +15%。
descEn: Villagers gather gold +15% faster.

desc: 村民采集石料的速度 +15%。
descEn: Villagers gather stone +15% faster.
